title: spathandra lutescens
intro: Spathandra lutescens, commonly known as the yellow spathandra, is a plant species in the family Annonaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Africa, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Spathandra lutescens include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat fever, cough, and respiratory infections.
